title: Tests good enough to catch a broken implementation
prompt: duration.js has no tests at all. Write duration.test.js (node:test) that pins down every rule documented on parseDuration, so that any of them breaking makes a test fail. Don't change duration.js.
check: "$HIVEY_EVAL_HIDDEN" js-mutation-tests && test -f duration.test.js && ! codeonly duration.test.js | grep -Eq 'node:fs|["'\'']fs["'\'']|readFile|createHash|child_process|require[(]' && node --test duration.test.js && sh mutants.sh
